scope: One actual-browser lifecycle using genuine native NFT/account contracts and an in-process disposable local EVM.

cases.name: native-workbench-reviewed-install-save-disable-and-recovery
checkpoints: Real owner connected and exact catalog package recovered without a transaction
Explicit installation signature executed through the native account
Draft stayed local until signature; UI and independent SDK recovered exact saved chain bytes
Reviewed disable mined; another live UI session closed and disabled relaunch was rejected
Receipts, disabled installation, retained state and original native identity independently rechecked

limitations: No extension or hardware wallet; injected EIP-1193 forwards exclusively to the local Ganache instance.
Shanghai Bound-mode native fixture uses OnchainRenderer; this is not the entire original Genesis runtime or proof-authorized flow.
No public deployment, real funds, physical device coverage or production certification.
